attribution.bettergov_notice: Independent and unofficial. This comparison is our own reading of the published documents, not an official record of the budget department, the agencies or the House. Figures are the amounts published in the documents, not spending. No allegations. An insertion, deletion, or amount-change candidate describes a provisional comparison between identified sources. That classification alone does not establish irregularity or wrongdoing by any office or official and should not be represented as such. Absence from an API snapshot likewise does not establish absence from the published NEP or concealment. Read the full notice: https://budget.bettergov.ph/hgab/2027/methodology#disclaimer.

overall_public_limitation: Not a complete list of national projects in San Fernando. BetterGov has no structured municipality/PSGC field, so lines were found by place and barangay names in titles and checked by hand; a line whose title does not name the City or one of its barangays may be missing. "House bill only" and "NEP only" are candidates for comparison, not confirmed insertions or deletions. Independent and unofficial; not an official record of DBM, the House of Representatives or any agency.

NEP and House Bill amounts are alternative versions of one budget and are compared, never added.
